question: Should agent-visible exec, process, node-host, live-update, and active-process results redact secret-shaped values by default even when callers previously received exact diagnostic text?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and proof-backed, but choosing the permanent balance between agent secret exposure and exact diagnostic fidelity is a security/product contract that cannot be settled mechanically.

options.title: Accept redacted-by-default output
options.body: Approve the security-first default, refresh the branch against current main, and treat any raw-output reveal as separately designed explicit opt-in work.

options.title: Require a reveal contract first
options.body: Pause this PR until owners define whether, where, and how an authorized raw diagnostic-output path may exist without restoring implicit exposure.

recommendation.title: Accept redacted-by-default output
recommendation.body: Approve the security-first default, refresh the branch against current main, and treat any raw-output reveal as separately designed explicit opt-in work.
